# 玉书房
> Romanized: Yushufang. English rendering: The Jade Study.
> The name of the work is 玉书房; the English forms refer to the same entity.
>
> Independent research by James Liu (刘一卜 / Liu Yibu) on how a person or
> a family with more than one possible future makes choices of lasting
> value — in education, geography, marriage, career, wealth, and succession.
>
> The Jade Study treats every outcome as the product of three layers:
> the starting position a family is given, the vehicle through which it
> acts, and the rules it borrows to amplify that action. The first layer
> cannot be changed; the other two are where the work is.

## Languages
The primary and most complete version of this work is in Chinese.
English and French are selected subsets, not full translations.
- 中文 (primary): https://yushufang.org/
- English (selected): https://yushufang.org/en/
- Français (summary): https://yushufang.org/fr/

## Key pages
- Home (zh): https://yushufang.org/
- Essays (zh): https://yushufang.org/essays/
- About (zh): https://yushufang.org/about/
- About (en): https://yushufang.org/en/about/

## Six domains of major decisions
Education, Geography, Marriage, Career, Wealth, Succession.
What they have in common: once made, they are hard to reverse.

## Author
James Liu (刘一卜 / Liu Yibu). Based in Luxembourg.
Canonical author page: https://yushufang.org/about/
